title: Vision Plans — Withdrawal, Free-Look Return, Voluntary Termination and Plan Change
content:
**Coverage changes the subscriber decides (Vision Plans).** Withdrawing an application, returning a plan in the free-look period, ending coverage and changing plans are the subscriber's own decisions. Each is registered by the agent as a coverage-change request and carried out after the subscriber confirms it. A vision withdrawal, free-look cancellation, voluntary termination or plan change is carried out only once the subscriber's vision coverage-change request for that enrollment is confirmed. That state is read from the request record for that enrollment, which must stand confirmed.

**Free-look return.** An individual subscriber may return the vision plan no later than the free-look period after the coverage effective date of the vision enrollment.
- The free-look period is the plan's free-look days (10), counted in calendar days from the coverage effective date.
- A request confirmed on the last day is in time.
- A free-look cancellation voids coverage from the start and credits back all premium.
- It is not available once any vision service has been paid.
- Group enrollments have no free-look right.

*Hypothetical dates:* coverage effective 1 July with a 10-day period gives a last day of 11 July. A request confirmed on 11 July is in time; one confirmed on 12 July is not.

**Voluntary termination.** Coverage ends on the last day of the calendar month in which the request is confirmed, and premium for later months is credited back. *Hypothetical:* a request confirmed on 9 October ends coverage on 31 October.

**Plan change.** An individual plan change takes effect only on the next benefit-period start after confirmation. A group enrollment changes plan only at the group's open enrollment or with a special enrollment. Frequencies already used continue to count after the change.

| Change | Available to | Takes effect |
|---|---|---|
| Withdrawal of an application | Applicant before coverage starts | Application cancelled |
| Free-look return | Individual subscribers, within the free-look period, no vision service yet paid | Coverage void from the start, all premium credited |
| Voluntary termination | Subscriber | Last day of the month of confirmation |
| Plan change | Individual: next benefit-period start; group: open enrollment or special enrollment | As stated |
